mean_stage.method: HistGB on log1p(E_mean_lux), inverted with expm1 and clipped at zero
mean_stage.reason: Inputs, hyperparameters and folds are unchanged; reuse and archive the seven previously fitted models instead of refitting them. Reproduce their held-out predictions from X only.

Weighted_log1p_P10.training_weight: w_r_raw = 1/sqrt(1 + mean(P10 for training room r)); normalize over training rows to mean weight 1
Weighted_log1p_P10.constraint: Compute means and weights using the six fitting rooms only; do not use the held-out room target scale.

Relative_P10.target: E_P10_lux / (E_mean_lux + 1 lux), computed only for training labels
Relative_P10.constraint: Both component models use only the same 13 raw inputs. No true held-out E_mean is passed to either model or to the primary reconstructed prediction. The ratio is not an F_UDI/F_300 spatial fraction and is not forcibly clipped to 1.

config.validation: Same seven TRAIN-only leave-one-room-out folds; 14 newly fitted P10 models and seven frozen mean-stage models
metrics: Room-wise original-lux MAE, RMSE, R2 and bias
Unweighted macro mean and median MAE over seven rooms
Change versus both references for every room
Error by month, hour and angle
config.secondary_error_decomposition: After inference and scoring only, decompose relative-method error as (r_hat - r_true)*(E_mean_true+1) + r_hat*(E_mean_hat-E_mean_true). These terms use held-out labels only for retrospective diagnosis, not for prediction, fitting or weight calculation. Absolute term magnitudes may cancel and do not add to MAE.
config.holdout_policy: Skip TEST rows before numeric conversion. No TEST predictions, scores, tuning, calibration or target distributions.
config.scope: Exploratory development follow-up after inspecting CV failures; no hyperparameter search, no new simulations, no source edits and no full-seven-room deployment refit. Existing EPW and geometry provenance limitations remain.
